caption: The drawing shows a rectangular wooden chest or cabinet with a flat top and four turned, carved legs. The cabinet is depicted in a brown color, suggesting a wood material. There is a small brass keyhole on the top portion of the front face, and a single round knob located beneath it, indicating a drawer or storage compartment. The background is plain and beige with no additional objects or decorations, and the artist’s name “Geo. V. Vezolles” is written in the lower right corner.
title: Shaker Sugar Chest
